svg.title: Queue ownership
svg.desc: Reference map: whole jobs wait in batch scheduling; async requests, results, and scheduled retries use external transport; pre-dispatch requests can wait in Endpoint Picker memory; dispatched work waits or runs inside one vLLM replica.

g.text: batch API enqueues · batch processor dequeues
Queued inference requests · terminal ResultItem values
Async Processor schedules · llm-d-async retry mover restores due work
EnqueueAndWait holds requests until Dispatched or an error
Local to the selected replica after Envoy dispatch
BEFORE HEADERS: 429 · AFTER RESPONSE STARTS: MAY RESET
INSIDE llm-d batch GATEWAY · ONE JOB LIFECYCLE
Other terminal paths: cancelling → cancelled · deadline expiry → expired · processing or finalization failure → failed
WHO SUPPLIES AND APPLIES REQUEST PRIORITY?
Default → header absent or default objective
2. applies spec.priority; absent objective or priority → 0
3. uses priority in FlowKey for pre-dispatch admission
Priority bands gate admission; only optional in-flight eviction is preemption.
The Endpoint Picker does not infer workload sensitivity from request contents.
The header names the object; poolRef binds the object to this InferencePool.
INSIDE ENDPOINT PICKER · REQUEST DECISION ORDER
Envoy retains the HTTP stream; Endpoint Picker returns a selected endpoint or ImmediateResponse error over ExtProc.
External alternatives: referenced InferencePool and/or HTTPRoute
Desired-state and reference relationships—not the runtime HTTP path.
REPORTED 21 AUG 2026 · NOT A LIVE INVENTORY
No model gateway reported in the service
Runtime flow and object relationships, not a cluster deployment manifest
SCALING QUESTIONS · NOT DESIGNED IN THIS LEARNER
Rejected work is not sent to a vLLM replica.
Client-visible outcome depends on response state
Response already started: stream may reset
This is not pre-dispatch queue rejection.
